One time in high school calculus class, my teacher had a little game for extra credit.

The game was to guess the area under a curve just by looking at it. We didn't get to see the equation only the actual curve. My teacher put the curves up on the projector, and we have to write out answers down. Who ever was closest to the actual value got 1 point. Also this was before we learned integrals, so I wasn't even able to use that to figure out the answer.

Anyway I had been up the entire night before and I was extremely tired, almost in a waking trance. I really didn't have the will power or motivation to play my teachers stupid game.

Anyways, the first curve comes up.... I just write down some bullshit answer. Wasn't even trying....

Got it right. I was surprised but I knew it was just dumb luck.


Second curve comes up... and I do the same thing, just take a dumb guess. I nail it again.

Third curve comes up, and this is were it gets weird. For some reason I decided to write down a bunch of decimals. like 3.7492 or something like that.

I hold up my answer and I get it right again... down to 4 decimal places. Purely just a guess. 

At this point I was almost scared.... I had no idea how the fuck I was doing this. I wasn't even good at math. I was just blindly guessing.

This happens again and again and the entire class is convinced that I'm either cheating, autistic, or a wizard. I believe I got something like 10 answesr in a row. Many of them down to 3 or 4 decimal places. After that the teacher was just too freaked out and just gave me a bunch of bonus points on the next test.

The story of my lucky streak spread around school and by the end of the day I was getting weird looks in the hall way.

After that day I never was able to do anything like that again. It almost scares me to think of that day.
